svg.title: When the cost is paid
svg.desc: A schematic of cost over eight conversations, for three designs. Full context writes nothing; on every request it reads the whole history, so the cost of each request grows with every conversation. A write-heavy memory, such as an extraction pipeline or a graph, pays for several model calls after each conversation, in the background, and puts a short selection of about the same size into every prompt. A rewritten profile pays for one call after each conversation and inserts a profile that stays about the same size. Write costs are paid once and can wait; read costs are paid on every request while the user waits.
svg.text: Work on the write path is paid once per conversation and can run in the background. Work on the read path is paid on
every request, while the user waits.
write: after the conversation, in the background
read: on the request, while the user waits
Schematic; heights show the shape only
